premise: A nationally reusable verification standard for local independent sports-bar food delivery. Local restaurants fulfill local deliveries, not coast-to-coast cooked-meal shipping.

requirements.rule: Written merchant opt-in and scope: brand, approved menu, fulfillment territory, prices, fees, refunds, hours. Without verified consent, no real listings/orders.
Confirm permit/inspection standing and applicable state/local retail food and transport law; generic FDA Food Code is a model, not automatically controlling in every state.

Use state-appropriate time/temperature controls. FDA Food Code 2022 reference hot TCS ≥135°F and cold TCS ≤41°F when temperature holding, with recognized time-control procedures as applicable; capture actual handling events.
Expose documented allergens, modifications, contact info and rejection if unsafe or cannot be met; never infer 'allergen free'.
Confirm item+modifier count and delivery eligibility; exclude dine-in-only specials unless merchant has approved a different fulfillment policy.
Use appropriate sealed/tamper-evident bags and leakproof containers; separate hot and cold items, sauces and crisp components as warranted.
Pickup and handoff timestamps, sealed-package exception events, optional temperature observations where appropriate; no customer photos required.
Each approved partner sets a feasible local radius, service hours, delivery fees and capacities. Nationwide platform coverage is a separate claim from one restaurant's local radius.
Only processor-authorized checkout with itemized prices, taxes, tips, delivery fees and refund policy. No live collection in draft.
Separate opt-in for each public post; no default publication, no public addresses, geolocation, faces of minors, employee details or delivery records; image rights and moderation checks.
Alcohol and other age-restricted items are DISABLED; only a separate jurisdiction-specific licensed, trained, age-verified flow could enable them.
Preserve exact document version and timestamps, source provenance, reproducible SHA-256 digest on authorized data, PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN per control; a digest does not certify food quality.

reference_laws.purpose: Model Food Code; may differ from Alabama adoption
Separate alcohol licensing and identity verification

pilot_design.scope: One merchant, one city, one food-only game-day session IF operator opts in
pilot_design.network_expansion: Local licensed partners by ZIP and service radius; no automatic rights to replicate any real menu
pilot_design.student_use: An offline synthetic math exercise; not labor, ordering, or public exposure of student media

hard_bans: No real merchant orders in draft
No user payment instruments or addresses
No AI review presented as a health inspection
